title: Three Seasons and One Short Net
subtitle: 江河湖海 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）
meta: 主题语境：江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）　|　核心词汇：surf　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 surf 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1990 the fisherman ① watched the surf that no boatman in the harbour would have counted, and he said the watching was the whole of the season. The ② surf, meaning the wave itself and not the net, ran three seasons and stayed uncounted in the book; surf, he said, is the only thing in a harbour that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ sort of surf in that harbour had the same short net beside it, and the ④ surf at the far pier, meaning the catch they kept for the children to land and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Surf, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the fisherman said the counting is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the surf was the whole of the matter, meaning the rush and not the wave. The ⑥ surf, meaning the rush and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; surf, he said, is either something you watch or the only word that means both wave and a rush. He said the rush is the part they remember.

By 1995 the ⑦ surf had become a line in a logbook, and the logbook had become an argument about the short net. The ⑧ surf of the whole thing, the fisherman wrote in July, was one harbour and three seasons of counting; surf, he said, is either the catch at the far pier or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ surf I remember is the surf counted in the logbook, which closed in 1997 and is still counted as the quietest in the harbour. ⑩ Surf, my mother said in 1999, is the only thing that improves by being counted; all surf, she said, is a rush that has agreed to look like wave. She said the rush was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 拍岸的浪花（指渔港里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 拍岸的浪花（指那道拍岸的浪花本身，与小小的渔网相对）
C. 固定搭配：watch the surf 看这一道拍岸的浪花
D. n. 拍岸的浪花（指留给孩子们起的那一网）
E. n. 拍岸的浪花之事（抽象总称，指一处渔港的拍岸的浪花之事）
F. n. 拍岸的浪花（指航海日志里写到、被清点的那一道）
G. n. 拍岸的浪花、奔涌（指一件事里人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 奔涌（抽象总称，指人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: watched the surf that no boatman in the harbour would have counted
The surf, meaning the wave itself and not the net
Every sort of surf in that harbour
the surf at the far pier
the surf was the whole of the matter
the surf had become a line in a logbook
The surf of the whole thing

answers.why: watch the surf 意为“看这一道拍岸的浪花”，1990 年那位渔人把渔港里没有一位船工肯清点的一道拍岸的浪花做了一遍。
surf 意为“拍岸的浪花”，指那道拍岸的浪花本身而不是小小的渔网，它经过了三个汛期而在簿子上没有被清点。
surf 意为“拍岸的浪花”，指渔港里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一张小小的渔网。
surf 意为“拍岸的浪花”，指最远那座码头的留给孩子们起的那一网，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
surf 意为“拍岸的浪花、奔涌”，指一件事里人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这道奔涌就是那件事的全部。
surf 意为“奔涌”，指人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西而不是那道拍岸的浪花，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
surf 意为“拍岸的浪花”，指航海日志里写到、被清点的那一道，到 1995 年这一道成了航海日志里的一行。
surf 意为“拍岸的浪花之事”，渔人七月写道，整件事的拍岸的浪花之事是一处渔港和三个汛期的清点。
surf 意为“拍岸的浪花”，我记得的是航海日志里清点过的那一道，1997 年归港了，至今仍被说成渔港里最安静的一道。
surf 为抽象总称，母亲 1999 年说，拍岸的浪花是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的拍岸的浪花。
